oxandrolone.summary: Anavar, a mild oral steroid used to stay lean while dieting by holding on to muscle for a harder-looking physique.

quick.overview:
Oxandrolone (Anavar) is an oral anabolic steroid developed in the 1960s. People use it for a lean, dry, harder-looking physique, and it has a reputation as one of the milder steroids for cutting.

It activates the androgen receptor with a relatively mild androgenic effect, which helps preserve muscle while calories are low, so staying lean is easier and the result looks denser. Unusually for its class, it has randomised trials in burn, trauma and wasting patients showing gains in weight and lean mass. Teen forum posts also discuss it for height, but growth studies show faster bone maturation without taller adult height.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral tablet during cutting phases, usually alongside a calorie deficit and heavy training, and sometimes stacked with other compounds. Medical use has been for restoring weight after burns, surgery or trauma. Users describe changes in fullness and definition building over several weeks of use.
quick.risks: Class risks include liver strain (its 17-alpha-methyl group allows oral use but is tied to liver toxicity), cardiovascular effects and suppression of natural hormones. It is US Schedule III and banned in sport, and unregulated products can be contaminated or fake. Anyone still growing should avoid it, since it speeds bone maturation.

angle.text: Oxandrolone (Anavar) is an oral steroid that people use to stay lean while dieting: its mild anabolic effect helps hold on to muscle, giving a leaner, harder-looking physique. Randomised trials have tested it in burns and wasting; teen height claims conflict with growth studies.

stanozolol.summary: Winstrol, a doping-famous steroid used for a dry, lean, hard look; approved for hereditary angioedema, with notable HDL and liver effects.

quick.overview:
Stanozolol (Winstrol) is an anabolic steroid that bodybuilders and athletes use for lean, dry, defined muscle. It became widely known through the 1988 Ben Johnson doping case.

It activates the androgen receptor, which helps retain muscle while water and softness drop, producing a hard, lean look. It is approved in the US for hereditary angioedema, where it raises liver production of C1 inhibitor, and is used in veterinary medicine. No controlled trial tests it for appearance in healthy people, and teen forum posts that ask about it for height are not backed by studies.
quick.how: It comes as an oral tablet and as an injectable, and users typically add it late in cutting phases alongside a calorie deficit and training. Users describe a drier, harder look developing over several weeks.
quick.risks: A study in weight lifters found oral stanozolol cut HDL cholesterol sharply; case reports and animal data describe liver injury, and reviews link anabolic steroids to cardiac deaths. It is US Schedule III and prohibited in sport. Anyone still growing should avoid it.

angle.text: Stanozolol (Winstrol) is a steroid used for a dry, lean, hard look: androgen signalling helps keep muscle while water and softness come off. It is approved for hereditary angioedema; forum posters also mention face and height, which studies do not address.

boldenone.summary: Equipoise, a veterinary steroid bodybuilders use for slow, steady lean mass gain and fuller muscle; no human trials exist.

quick.overview:
Boldenone is an injectable anabolic steroid best known as Equipoise, a veterinary drug for horses. Bodybuilders use it for slow, steady muscle gain and a fuller, more muscular physique.

It is a testosterone analogue that activates the androgen receptor, and users report it increases red blood cell production and appetite. Its long-acting ester releases slowly after injection, which is why gains are described as gradual. No human trials of boldenone were found, so claims about appearance rest on user reports.
quick.how: Users add it to longer bulking or lean-gain phases, often with other compounds, and describe results building gradually over many weeks. It is sourced from veterinary products, which is outside medical channels.
quick.risks: Animal studies report reproductive, liver, kidney and immune effects. It is not approved for humans in the US and is prohibited in sport. Because it is a veterinary product, quality and content are not guaranteed.

angle.text: Boldenone (Equipoise) is a veterinary steroid that bodybuilders use for slow, steady lean mass gain, building a fuller, more muscular physique over a long run. It is approved for horses rather than humans, and no human trials of its effects exist.

methandienone.summary: Dianabol, the classic oral bulking steroid; small controlled trials show lean mass gain, with liver, blood-pressure and hormonal costs.

quick.overview:
Methandienone, historically sold as Dianabol, is an oral anabolic-androgenic steroid taken by strength athletes and bodybuilders for rapid gains in size and fullness. On bodybuilding and looksmaxxing forums it is described as the traditional first-choice oral for bulking.

It is a synthetic testosterone derivative that activates the androgen receptor. Several small double-blind crossover trials from the 1970s and early 1980s, mostly in trained men on a high dose, found increases in body weight, lean mass, body potassium and nitrogen. Strength gains were significant in some trials and not in others, and some researchers noted part of the weight gain could be water.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral tablet, usually in a bulking phase with heavy training and a calorie surplus, often alongside testosterone. Weight and fullness changes are reported within the first few weeks.
quick.risks: Controlled trials and case reports document water retention, raised systolic blood pressure, side effects that led participants to withdraw, suppression of natural testosterone and, in a published case, severe cholestatic liver injury with kidney failure in a bodybuilder also using another steroid. It is prohibited in sport and legally restricted in many countries.

angle.text: Methandienone (Dianabol) is the classic oral bulking steroid, used for fast gains in size and fullness, much of it water at first. Small controlled trials in trained men found increases in lean mass; blood pressure and liver effects were also recorded.

oxymetholone.summary: Anadrol, an anemia drug that bodybuilders use as a potent oral bulker for mass and fullness, with well-documented liver effects.

quick.overview:
Oxymetholone (Anadrol) is an oral anabolic-androgenic steroid approved in some countries for anemias caused by bone-marrow failure. Bodybuilders use it as a strong oral for rapid mass and a full look, and some forum posters say it masculinises the face and body.

It is a 17-alpha-alkylated derivative of dihydrotestosterone that activates the androgen receptor and also stimulates red-cell production, which is why it is used in anemia. A general reference text describes lean-mass gains in short-term wasting studies. The published research concerns medical use, not physique outcomes in healthy people.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral tablet during bulking phases, often alongside injectable testosterone, and describe quick gains in weight and muscle fullness. Hematology use is for inherited and acquired marrow failure under medical supervision.
quick.risks: Reviews of androgen therapy for marrow failure report virilization and liver toxicity as major adverse events, and case series link oral androgens to peliosis hepatis and liver tumours. Forum users also discuss unfavourable cholesterol effects and gynecomastia. It is a controlled substance in many places and banned in sport.

angle.text: Oxymetholone (Anadrol) is an anemia drug that bodybuilders use as a powerful oral bulker, adding mass, water and muscle fullness for a bigger physique. Trials cover anemia and wasting rather than physique, and liver effects are well documented.

drostanolone.summary: Masteron, a DHT-derived injectable used by bodybuilders for a dry, hard, defined look; historically a breast-cancer drug.

quick.overview:
Drostanolone, widely known as Masteron, is an injectable steroid derived from dihydrotestosterone. Bodybuilders use it as an add-on for a dry, hard, defined look when lean, and forum posters also discuss its effects on skin and hair.

It is a 2-alpha-methyl derivative of DHT, so it activates the androgen receptor and is not converted to estrogen by aromatase, which is why users link it to less softness and water. Medically it was tested from the 1960s to the 1980s as hormone therapy for advanced breast cancer. No study has measured its effect on physique, face or skin in healthy users.
quick.how: Users add it to a cutting phase alongside testosterone or other compounds, with a calorie deficit and training. The propionate ester is the usual injectable form, and users describe the look tightening over several weeks.
quick.risks: Breast-cancer trials judged side effects generally not serious in that setting. Forum users warn about hair loss in those predisposed, since DHT-derived compounds are not blocked by finasteride or dutasteride in their account, and about skin and cardiovascular effects of stacks. It is detected in anti-doping controls and prohibited in sport.

angle.text: Drostanolone (Masteron) is an injectable DHT-derived steroid that bodybuilders add during cuts to keep muscle and get a dry, hard, defined look. Human trials were in breast cancer; users also discuss its effects on hair and skin.

mesterolone.summary: Proviron, a mild oral DHT derivative used medically for hypogonadism and fertility, and by users as an add-on for hardness and libido.

quick.overview:
Mesterolone, best known as Proviron, is an oral androgen derived from dihydrotestosterone. Users add it to testosterone for libido, a drier and harder look, and, among younger users, as a way to raise DHT, sometimes under the label of puberty maxxing.

It is a 1-alpha-methyl derivative of DHT that acts on the androgen receptor and is not converted to estrogen. Clinically it has been used for male hypogonadism and tested for male infertility with mixed results. One detailed forum self-report described stronger erections and a slightly drier look with no change in strength or muscle mass; no study has examined its appearance effects.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral tablet, most often as an add-on to testosterone or other compounds rather than alone. Reported changes are mild and described over weeks of use.
quick.risks: One reference describes a low risk of liver toxicity relative to other oral androgens, but safety data in healthy users are limited to forum reports. Users raise DHT-related concerns such as hair loss and discuss whether use suppresses the natural hormonal axis. It is prohibited in sport.

angle.text: Mesterolone (Proviron) is a mild oral DHT derivative that users add for a harder, drier, more masculine look, libido and, among younger users, puberty-maxxing. It is used medically for hypogonadism and fertility; hair loss is a common concern among users.

methyltestosterone.summary: An early oral testosterone analogue still used medically for hypogonadism and menopause, with little documented use for muscle or looks.

quick.overview:
Methyltestosterone is one of the earliest orally active forms of testosterone. It has been used for male hypogonadism, in women with estrogens for menopausal symptoms, and in hereditary angioedema; the payoff relevant to looks is androgen replacement, which supports muscle and masculine traits.

It is testosterone with a methyl group at the 17-alpha position, which allows oral dosing and acts on the androgen receptor. No trial has tested it for muscle or facial appearance, and no community threads about it were found. The most relevant human study is a 1993 NIH trial in healthy men that measured mood and behavior effects over two weeks.
quick.how: Medically it is taken as an oral tablet, in men for hypogonadism and in women as combination estrogen-methyltestosterone tablets for menopausal symptoms. It is not a common choice in bodybuilding or looksmaxxing circles.
quick.risks: Reported risks include virilization in women, liver toxicity, mood changes and a drug interaction with cyclosporine. Combination estrogen-methyltestosterone tablets carry a boxed warning about endometrial cancer risk and are Pregnancy Category X. It is prohibited in sport.

angle.text: Methyltestosterone is an oral testosterone analogue that raises androgen levels, which supports muscle and masculine traits in men with hypogonadism. Medical use covers hypogonadism and menopausal therapy; it is rarely discussed for physique.

fluoxymesterone.summary: Halotestin, a strong oral androgen that bodybuilders add for hardness, strength and aggression; trials are in breast cancer and hypogonadism.

quick.overview:
Fluoxymesterone, sold as Halotestin, is an oral androgen first described in the 1950s. Bodybuilders add it for hardness, strength and drive rather than size, aiming for a harder, denser-looking physique.

It is a testosterone derivative with a fluorine atom and a 17-alpha methyl group that allow oral use and strong androgenic activity relative to its anabolic effect. In medicine it was used for male hypogonadism and delayed puberty and as palliative therapy for advanced breast cancer. Published trials are in breast cancer and anemia, not physique.
quick.how: Users take it as a short-acting oral, typically in small amounts alongside other compounds in cutting or pre-competition phases. One forum poster described pairing it with a growth-hormone secretagogue.
quick.risks: Forum users and a literature summary link long-term use of 17-alpha-alkylated androgens to liver adenomas, jaundice and lipid changes, and users describe aggression as a reported effect. Medical use has declined, and US brand production reportedly ceased in 2014.

angle.text: Fluoxymesterone (Halotestin) is a strong oral androgen that users add for strength, hardness and drive, giving a harder, denser-looking physique more than extra size. Trials cover hypogonadism and breast cancer; liver and aggression effects are discussed by users.

methenolone.summary: Primobolan, a mild DHT-derived steroid prized in bodybuilding for lean gains with fewer side effects; human trials are in anemia, cancer and rehabilitation.

quick.overview:
Methenolone (Primobolan) is an anabolic-androgenic steroid derived from dihydrotestosterone, available as an oral acetate and an injectable enanthate. In bodybuilding and looksmaxxing forums it is regarded as a mild compound for lean gains with fewer estrogenic effects, for a leaner, harder physique.

It binds the androgen receptor and promotes protein synthesis, and the enanthate is a long-acting injectable. Controlled studies are medical: a 1979 trial in refractory anemias, 1975 and later work in breast cancer, and a 2011 randomized trial in 26 stroke patients in which weekly injections increased thigh muscle area compared with controls. No study has tested it for physique in healthy people.
quick.how: Users add it to lean-gain or cutting phases, often with other compounds, and describe slow, steady changes over a long run. The oral acetate is limited by first-pass liver metabolism, while the enanthate is a long-acting injectable.
quick.risks: Trials in refractory anemia reported negligible side effects, but one trial found more marked anemia and thrombocytopenia in lymphoma patients given methenolone during chemotherapy, and a rat study found worse cirrhosis-like liver changes with the acetate. Forum users report liver problems and dispute how harsh it is on lipids. It is prohibited in sport.

angle.text: Methenolone (Primobolan) is a mild DHT-derived steroid that users favour for lean muscle gain with fewer side effects, building a leaner, harder physique. A 2011 randomized trial in stroke patients found thigh-muscle gains; trials in healthy people for physique are absent.

trestolone-ment.summary: Trestolone (MENT), an experimental potent androgen built for male contraception and replacement, discussed on looksmax forums for muscle and topical jawline ideas.

quick.overview:
Trestolone, also called MENT (7-alpha-methyl-19-nortestosterone), is an experimental synthetic androgen developed for male hormonal contraception and androgen replacement. In bodybuilding and looksmaxxing spaces it is discussed as a very potent anabolic for muscle, and in one looksmax.org thread as a topical androgen that might remodel the jawline.

It is a potent androgen-receptor agonist with progestogenic activity that is not converted to DHT by 5-alpha-reductase and suppresses gonadotropins, which is the basis of its contraceptive research. The only human research located is a registered phase 1 trial of its effects on blood pressure in 68 normal men. The jawline idea is a forum hypothesis, and other users questioned it.
quick.how: It has no approved form. Forum discussion centres on potent androgen use for muscle and on the idea of applying androgens to the jaw area for facial remodeling, which remains speculation.
quick.risks: It has never been approved, so safety knowledge comes from small research studies. Forum users anticipate acne, skin irritation and more facial hair from the topical idea, and one asked that any tester be someone not prone to acne or baldness.

angle.text: Trestolone is discussed on looksmax forums as a potent androgen that might remodel the jawline when applied locally, and as a strong muscle builder. The facial idea is a forum hypothesis; the drug itself was studied as a male contraceptive and replacement androgen.

dimethandrolone-undecanoate.summary: DMAU, an experimental oral androgen-progestin built as a male contraceptive pill; forum users speculate about muscle, with no human data on it.

quick.overview:
Dimethandrolone undecanoate (DMAU) is an experimental oral drug that acts as both an androgen and a progestin. It is being developed mainly as a male contraceptive pill and secondarily for androgen replacement, and forum users speculate it could work as an oral anabolic for muscle.

After ingestion the ester is cleaved to dimethandrolone, which activates androgen and progesterone receptors and is not converted to estrogen by aromatase in laboratory tests. In men it suppresses LH, FSH, testosterone and estradiol. Human trials so far are short studies in healthy men looking at safety, pharmacokinetics and hormone suppression; none has tested muscle or appearance.
quick.how: It is not available as a medicine; research use has been as a once-daily oral in clinical trials. In forums it appears mostly as a news item about male contraception or as a hypothetical oral anabolic.
quick.risks: Not approved anywhere. Short trials report hormone suppression, effects on bone turnover markers and metabolic changes; long-term safety is not established. Hormonal male contraceptives as a class face problems with side effects and non-response.

angle.text: Forum users speculate that DMAU could become an oral anabolic, since it is a potent androgen that works by mouth and could add muscle mass. It was developed as a male contraceptive pill; trials looked at hormone levels and safety rather than muscle or looks.

methasterone.summary: Superdrol, an oral designer steroid once sold as a supplement; users report fast lean muscle gain, while case reports document liver and kidney injury.

quick.overview:
Methasterone is a lab-made oral steroid sold in the 2000s in the US as a bodybuilding supplement called Superdrol. Users take it for quick lean muscle gain with little water retention, giving a fuller, more muscular physique.

It is an androgen-receptor agonist derived from dihydrotestosterone, with a 17-alpha methyl group that lets it work when swallowed; animal assays suggest a high anabolic-to-androgenic ratio. It was never approved as a medicine and no human trial of its effects exists. Claims of fast gains come from forum logs, and some posters claim non-aromatizing steroids add height in teenagers, which is untested.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral tablet or capsule during short mass-gain phases, usually with heavy training, and report lean gains within the first weeks. It was originally marketed as a prohormone supplement, though it acts as a steroid itself.
quick.risks: Case reports describe cholestatic jaundice, kidney injury and hospitalisation, and a supplement cluster in New York involved liver damage. Users also report suppressed testosterone, gynecomastia and lipid changes. It is a controlled substance in the US and banned in sport.

angle.text: Methasterone (Superdrol) is an oral steroid that users take for rapid lean muscle gain with little water retention, building a fuller physique. Claims rest on user reports and animal assays; published human reports are mostly of liver and kidney problems.

androstenedione.summary: A weak natural androgen once sold as the 1990s baseball-era testosterone-booster supplement; trials found no strength or muscle gains at ordinary doses.

quick.overview:
Androstenedione is a hormone the body makes as a step toward testosterone and estrogen. In the 1990s it was sold as a supplement to raise testosterone and build muscle and strength, and became famous through professional baseball.

The body converts it to testosterone, or to estrone by aromatase, so any effect depends on how much converts; it is itself only a weak androgen. Controlled studies found that ordinary doses did not improve strength, muscle size or body fat, and a single large dose raised testosterone only briefly while also raising estradiol.
quick.how: It was sold as an over-the-counter oral supplement. After it was banned, relabelled analogues such as 1-andro appeared in supplements.
quick.risks: A study in women reported masculinising effects and menstrual disruption, and estrogenic effects are a concern in men. It was banned as a supplement in 2004 and has been a Schedule III controlled substance in the US since 2005; it is banned in major sports.

angle.text: Androstenedione was sold in the 1990s as a testosterone booster for more muscle and strength, by converting into testosterone in the body. Controlled trials at ordinary doses measured strength and muscle size and did not find gains; it also converts toward estrogen.

dhea.summary: A natural adrenal hormone sold as an over-the-counter anti-aging and testosterone-support pill, studied for vaginal atrophy and used for skin and vitality.

quick.overview:
DHEA is a hormone made by the adrenal glands that the body turns into testosterone and estrogen. Levels fall with age, which is why it is sold as an anti-aging and hormone-support supplement, taken for younger-looking skin, vitality and muscle, and in some forum posts for height.

It acts mostly as a precursor converted in tissues to androgens and estrogens, with some direct activity in the brain; its sulfate form, DHEA-S, acts as a long-lasting reservoir. Trials support the vaginal form for menopausal atrophy. For muscle, skin or looks in healthy people, evidence is limited.
quick.how: People take it as an oral over-the-counter supplement, often with an anti-aging or testosterone-support routine, and a prescription vaginal form (prasterone) exists. Users on testosterone therapy report mixed experiences.
quick.risks: In the US it is sold over the counter, but some countries restrict it and it is prohibited in sport. Because it converts to sex hormones, hormonal effects such as acne or changes in estrogen and androgen levels are possible.

angle.text: DHEA is taken as an anti-aging supplement: it converts to androgens and estrogens, which people hope will support skin, muscle and vitality as natural levels decline with age. Trials support the vaginal form for atrophy; skin and muscle use in healthy people has been studied less.

dihydrotestosterone-dht.summary: The potent androgen behind puberty changes; DHT gel is used on forums hoping for a more masculine face, beard and penis size.

quick.overview:
DHT is a hormone made from testosterone that shapes male genital development and puberty changes, drives facial and body hair, and is also the hormone behind male-pattern baldness. Forum users apply DHT gel hoping for a more masculine face, a stronger jaw, beard growth or penis size.

DHT binds the androgen receptor more strongly than testosterone does and cannot turn into estrogen. Applied as a gel, it is absorbed through the skin and raises DHT in the blood. DHT gel has been studied in older men with low testosterone and used in boys with micropenis; no trial has tested it for looks in people without a hormonal disorder.
quick.how: Users apply a topical gel, often homemade or compounded, and some do so during puberty hoping to influence facial structure. Others take the opposite approach and lower DHT with finasteride or dutasteride for hair.
quick.risks: Users and a forum-cited study describe suppression of the body's own testosterone with DHT gel. Androgens can cause acne and mood changes, and their effect on adolescent growth is unstudied. DHT gel is not an approved US product.

angle.text: DHT gel is used on forums to masculinize the face, strengthen the jaw and add beard or penis size, building on DHT's role as the androgen that drives facial and body hair at puberty. The facial bone and size claims for applied gel come from user reports, not trials.

human-chorionic-gonadotropin-hcg.summary: The pregnancy hormone that fertility clinics and TRT doctors use to keep the testes working; forum claims for face, height and penis growth are untested.

quick.overview:
hCG is the hormone made by the placenta that pregnancy tests detect. It mimics luteinizing hormone, so doctors use it to trigger ovulation and to stimulate the testes in some men with hypogonadism. Men on testosterone or steroids use it to keep testes working, which maintains natural testosterone production and a fuller look.

It binds the luteinizing hormone receptor, which in men stimulates the testes to make testosterone and supports sperm production that is otherwise suppressed when outside testosterone shuts down the pituitary signal. Some forum posts also pair it with growth hormone or DHT gel hoping for facial, height or penile growth; no trial supports those uses.
quick.how: It is a prescription injectable used by men on testosterone therapy or steroids to preserve testicular function and fertility, and in clinics for fertility treatment and inducing puberty in hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.
quick.risks: It is prescription-only in the US, and non-prescription hCG weight-loss products are unapproved. Because it raises testosterone and so estradiol, users report needing to monitor hormones. Ovarian hyperstimulation is a known complication in fertility treatment.

angle.text: Men on testosterone therapy use hCG to keep the testes active, which maintains natural testosterone and fertility and a fuller, more masculine look. Some looksmaxxers add it hoping for facial or penile growth; the testicular use is established medically, the growth claims have not been tested.

andarine-s-4.summary: An unapproved SARM from the early 2000s that users take during cuts to hold on to muscle; only animal data exist, and yellow-green vision is widely reported.

quick.overview:
Andarine (S-4) is an experimental SARM, a drug designed to act like testosterone on muscle and bone with fewer effects elsewhere. Users take it during cutting phases to hold on to muscle while losing fat, aiming for a leaner, more muscular physique, and posters say it spares hair compared with steroids.

It is a non-steroidal compound that binds the androgen receptor and does not convert to estrogen or DHT; in animal experiments it acted as a full agonist in muscle and bone and a partial agonist in the prostate. Only animal studies exist, including restoration of muscle mass in castrated rats.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral product during cuts, often alongside other compounds, with a calorie deficit and training. It is sold as a research chemical rather than as a medicine.
quick.risks: Vision disturbances, a yellow or green tint and poor night vision, are widely reported by users. Forum posts also cite unfavourable cholesterol changes and product contamination concerns. It is unapproved, illegal to sell for human consumption in many places, and banned in sport.

angle.text: Andarine is a SARM that users take during cuts to hold on to muscle while losing fat, giving a leaner, more muscular physique; posters say it spares hair compared with steroids. Research is in animals, and users commonly report a yellow-green tint to vision.

cardarine-gw501516.summary: A discontinued metabolic drug sold as a fat-loss and endurance aid; small trials showed lipid benefits, and rodent cancer findings ended its development.

quick.overview:
Cardarine (GW501516) is an experimental drug that activates PPAR-delta, a receptor that turns up fat burning in muscle. It is sold alongside SARMs and used in cuts for fat loss and endurance, often described as a milder alternative to clenbuterol for getting lean.

By activating PPAR-delta it raises expression of genes for fatty acid transport and oxidation in muscle and has been described as mimicking some effects of exercise. GSK developed it for cholesterol and metabolic disease and stopped in 2007. Small human trials showed better triglycerides, HDL and fat oxidation, but none was designed to test weight or fat loss in healthy people.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral product during cutting or endurance phases, usually alongside diet and training and often stacked with SARMs. It is sold as a research chemical, not a medicine.
quick.risks: Rodent studies found tumour development in several organs, which led GSK to halt research, and there are no long-term human safety data. It is banned by WADA and unapproved, and some countries such as Australia have scheduled it.

angle.text: Cardarine is used as a fat-loss and endurance aid: it activates PPAR-delta, which raises fat burning in muscle and supports a leaner physique. Small trials measured lipid and metabolic markers rather than appearance, and development stopped after rodent cancer findings.

sr9009-stenabolic.summary: A REV-ERB clock-receptor agonist sold as Stenabolic for endurance and cutting; research is in cells and animals, with a liver-injury case report.

quick.overview:
SR9009, sold as Stenabolic, is a lab compound that switches on REV-ERB, receptors that tie the body clock to metabolism. It is sold online for endurance and fat loss, used for cutting and often stacked with cardarine, and is often called a SARM though research classifies it differently.

It activates REV-ERBα and REV-ERBβ, which repress clock and metabolic genes; the endurance and fat-loss effects come from mouse studies. Several studies report effects that appear independent of REV-ERB, so its mechanism is not settled. All published work is in cells and animals, and no human trial has tested it for appearance or performance.
quick.how: Users take it as an oral research-chemical product during cutting or endurance phases, often combined with other compounds, which makes it hard to tell what causes any change.
quick.risks: Human safety is not established. A 2025 case report describes liver injury after starting a product sold as Stenabolic. It is not an approved drug, and stacking with other compounds confounds any reported effects.

angle.text: SR9009 is used for endurance and cutting: by activating the REV-ERB clock receptors it is said to raise energy use and support a leaner look, often stacked with cardarine. The effects come from mouse studies; it is not a SARM despite being sold alongside them.
